tools.name: vibemail.draft_status
tools.description: Read VibeMail's saved mail drafts and the last submission record for the current account (host-verified compose ledger). Read-only: it never composes, sends or deletes. The Shell binds the app's current account; stale or cross-account parameters are refused.

tools.name: vibemail.glance_cards
tools.description: List the Glance cards this app has published (card_id, title, priority, published_at, expires_at). Read-only: publication and withdrawal stay with the app's foreground UI.
